# AI Knowledge — Java Edition

> Standalone Java 21 / Spring Boot single-organization knowledge management workbench. Evidence-grounded RAG with Milvus and OpenAI-compatible models is the roadmap, not a completed capability.

## Read first

- [README](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/README.md): runnable features, limitations, setup and configuration.
- [AI context](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/docs/AI_CONTEXT.md): source map and implementation status.
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/AGENTS.md): development and verification constraints.

## Engineering

- [Architecture](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules, authority and planned retrieval.
- [Java standards](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/docs/JAVA_DEVELOPMENT_STANDARDS.md): approved layer-first Spring responsibilities, Model and Security boundaries, Alibaba-inspired project rules and Occam's razor.
- [API](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/docs/API.md): actual HTTP endpoints only.
- [Text adapters](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/docs/TEXT_ADAPTERS.md): model/Milvus configuration; indexing and opt-in backend answers use the adapters, with real-provider acceptance still incomplete.
- [Text ingestion](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/docs/TEXT_INGESTION.md): opt-in uploads and persistent parsed evidence.
- [Text indexing](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/docs/TEXT_INDEXING.md): opt-in separate JVM, bounded tasks, full-revision verification, v3 migration and publication authority.
- [Document lifecycle](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/docs/changes/0008-document-lifecycle/spec.md): opt-in withdrawal, in-flight cancellation, current-query and source invalidation; physical cleanup and reindexing remain incomplete.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): incomplete migration work and acceptance gates.
- [Verification](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/docs/VERIFICATION.md): measured checks, scope and exclusions.
- [Security](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/SECURITY.md): secrets, threat scope and reporting.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): intent/spec/plan/review/evidence workflow.

## Important limitations

Ingestion, indexing, answers and document withdrawal have independent, default-off opt-ins restricted to literal loopback in development/test. Indexing calls embedding and Milvus; answers use authorized hybrid retrieval, reranking and server-verified extraction. Source revisions differ from per-attempt physical generations. Current authorization is rechecked before evidence delivery and final answer commit; v4 traces retain the complete scope. Frontend answer controls and multimodal processing remain unimplemented.

Schema v5 adds immutable document tombstones. Withdrawal returns deleting/pending, cancels active tasks transactionally and invalidates current lists, retrieval and old source access. It does not erase retained originals, evidence, vector data or backups; stored-byte quota is unchanged. Physical cleanup, completion receipts and reindexing require further implementation. Restoring an older backup does not preserve later removal requests. Disabling the withdrawal endpoint does not disable current tombstone filtering.

Separate processes and a local cross-JVM lease are not an OS sandbox or revocation of upstream HTTP requests. Production startup is blocked and readiness remains 503. Real-provider/Milvus evidence is limited to the exact cases in the verification records; no complete RAG, multimodal, performance or production acceptance is implied. Historical manifests do not certify newer source. Search-engine or AI indexing is not guaranteed.
